name: Golden Hour Glow by D'Ann Boal
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Golden Hour Glow imaging recipe provides a hit of golden warmth throughout the frame while enhancing contrast. It is meant for photos with warm tones taken during golden hour, or environmental portraits with dominant yellow tones that you want to warm up. Yellow tones transform into honey hues, while greens are deepened and warmed. Both saturation and highlights are increased, allowing the light in the frame to shimmer with an amber-colored vibrance.
Photographing with warmer tones during the golden hour can infuse an image with abundant light and bright colors, but it can also present photography challenges. Skin tones may fall into shadow, images can appear flat, and color casts may dominate.
